fixtures.prompt: 收工。本 session 修复了 validation repair-loop 漏掉 empty panel list 的问题，根因是 schema guard 在 export 前才运行；我们比较过 export fallback 和 upfront validation，最后选择把 deterministic schema check 前移。
fixtures.expected_behavior: Classify the session as repair, produce a source=session-recap raw entry with motivation, root_cause, exploration_paths, and impact when inferable. Do not ask the user extra questions only to satisfy optional fields.

assertions.name: repair_archetype
assertions.description: The raw entry or Markdown recap identifies archetype=repair.

assertions.name: root_cause_preserved
assertions.description: The root cause explains that schema guarding happened too late in the flow.

assertions.name: alternatives_preserved
assertions.description: The comparison between export fallback and upfront validation is preserved as exploration or abandoned-alternative signal.

fixtures.prompt: 用 $lode-weekly-outline 写本周技术型周报。raw entries 包含 archetype-tagged session-recap，并带 artifact_context 描述 validation contract split；git log 也有同一变更的 commit。

raw_entries.summary: Split storyboard validation into deterministic schema checks and LLM-assisted repair loops
raw_entries.context: Single-pass validation hid recurring panel continuity failures until export time. The split gives future debugging a stable contract boundary.
raw_entries.motivation: Export-time validation made failures expensive to debug and blurred repair ownership.
exploration_paths: Keep repair logic in export -> lower migration cost but preserves hidden ownership
Move deterministic schema checks before repair loop -> clearer contract boundary
raw_entries.impact: Weekly outline can explain the validation ownership split without reading implementation commits.

artifact_context.scope: Validation-stage ownership between schema checks, repair loops, and export compatibility.
artifact_context.delta: Recorded export as a consumer rather than a hidden repair stage.
open_questions: Whether repair-loop latency needs a separate budget.

fallback_git_logs: abc1234 feat: split validation schema checks and repair loop
def5678 docs: document validation stage ownership

fixtures.expected_behavior: Produce one Storyboard reliability work stream. Use motivation and artifact_context from session-recap as the primary narrative/evidence source, and use git commits only as coverage evidence.

assertions.name: single_work_stream
assertions.description: The session-recap entry and matching git commits do not become duplicate streams.

assertions.name: artifact_context_used
assertions.description: The stream includes both motivation and contract evidence from the session-recap artifact_context.

assertions.name: git_not_primary
assertions.description: Git commits are treated as coverage/evidence, not the main narrative source.

fixtures.prompt: 用 $lode-weekly-outline 写本周周报。没有 raw entries，但 repo path 有效，请从 git log fallback 生成。

fallback_git_logs: aaa1111 feat: add validation retry loop
bbb2222 fix: handle empty panel list

fixtures.expected_behavior: Generate a usable outline, filter chore noise, and mark fallback-only streams as lower confidence or evidence-limited.

assertions.name: fallback_only_labeled
assertions.description: The output clearly marks the narrative as fallback-only, lower-confidence, or evidence-limited.

assertions.name: noise_filtered
assertions.description: The chore-only commit is not promoted into a main work stream.
